edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient and is filtered only by Address.isContract.
msg.sender must own the fed twig through onlyTwigOwner.
onlyTwigOwner compares msg.sender with ownerOf(_twigId).
msg.sender is forwarded as the _recipient of the internal mint.
TransferGraft authenticates the caller as source twig owner before moving grafts.
PlantGraft authenticates the caller as twig owner before minting a new twig.
transferOwnership is restricted to the current owner via onlyOwner.
WithdrawFunds is restricted to the owner but drains the contract balance.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness seed, making it miner-influenceable.
Mint price is derived from block.timestamp relative to FireSaleStartTime.
plantTime and graft stopTime are written from block.timestamp.
Feed rewrites graft stopTime from block.timestamp.
PlantGraft requires graft stopTime to be before block.timestamp.
StartFireSaleOn requires the supplied time to be after block.timestamp.
RenderTwig injects block.timestamp into the rendered script.
_tokenIdCounter is incremented once per minted token.
_internalMint writes TwigDetails for every new token id.
_internalMint pushes randomly generated GraftDetails entries.
_internalMint appends the new token id to GenLists[_twigGen].
_graftsCounter is incremented for each generated graft.
PublicMint adds msg.value/10 to TotalDonationOwed.
Feed adds 9*(msg.value/10) to TotalDonationOwed.
Feed sets the fed flag on the twig record.
AdminMint increases _reservedTokensCounter by _numTokens.
SetScript stores the owner supplied script while unlocked.
LockScript permanently sets ScriptLocked to true.
SetMinPrice overwrites the base mint price.
StartFireSaleOn overwrites the fire sale timestamp.
SetMetaURI overwrites the metadata base URI.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner address.
owner() reads the stored owner address.
GetTwigData depends on state written under timestamp-driven pricing.
CheckGraft reads the graft array of the given twig.
TransferGraft pushes, swaps and pops graft entries.
PlantGraft removes the consumed graft via swap-and-pop.
GetTwigData iterates the graft array to build the script.
tokenURI concatenates metaUri with on-chain twig data.
tokenURI reads gen, plantTime and fed from TwigsData.
PublicMint calls _internalMint after payment validation.
PublicMint requires msg.value >= GetMintPrice() * _numTokens.
AdminMint delegates minting to _internalMint with generation 0.
PlantGraft mints the next generation twig via _internalMint.
Feed gates execution on onlyTwigOwner.
TransferGraft gates execution on onlyTwigOwner for the source twig.
PlantGraft gates execution on onlyTwigOwner for the source twig.
TransferGraft locates the graft position with CheckGraft.
PlantGraft locates the graft position with CheckGraft.
_internalMint uses random() for graft count and stop times.
tokenURI converts numeric fields with uint2str.
RenderTwig builds on the output of GetTwigData.
GetTwigData serialises fields via uint2str.
RenderTwig serialises block.timestamp via uint2str.
GetTwigData resolves the owner with ownerOf.
WithdrawFunds performs a native value transfer to an owner-chosen address.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract before state finalisation of the external callee.
_numTokens bounds the mint quantity and the required payment in PublicMint.
_twigId selects which twig record Feed mutates.
_twigId is the ownership-checked source twig in TransferGraft.
_graftId selects which graft is moved.
_newTwigId receives the graft without any existence or ownership validation.
pos indexes the graft array for the swap-and-pop move.
_twigId is the ownership-checked source twig in PlantGraft.
_graftId selects the graft that will be consumed.
pos indexes the graft array for maturity check and removal.
target is the recipient of the reserved mint.
_numTokens is summed against the 50 token reservation cap.
target is the destination of the withdrawn ETH.
amount is the wei value transferred out.
_script is stored in the render script state variable.
_price becomes the new minimum mint price.
_time schedules the fire sale start.
_uri replaces the metadata base URI.
_twigId selects the twig whose script is rendered.
_renderCfg is interpolated directly into the returned script string.
_twigId selects which twig data is serialised.
returnScript accumulates the serialised twig and graft data.
_recipient receives every token minted by the loop.
_numTokens controls the number of loop iterations and mints.
_twigGen is clamped to 9 and used as the GenLists index.
_graftGen indexes GRAFT_GEN_MIN and GRAFT_GEN_MAX.
i drives the mint loop iteration count.
numGrafts bounds the inner graft creation loop.
g drives the inner graft creation loop.
min is the inclusive lower bound of the modulo range.
max participates in ((max+1)-min) which would underflow if min > max+1.
_twigId is validated with _exists and used for metadata lookups.
gen indexes the GenLists mapping returned to the caller.
daysSinceFire is computed from the timestamp delta, integer-divided and clamped.
_twigId selects the graft array to search.
_graftId is compared against each stored graft id.
g iterates the graft array during the lookup.
_twigId is used for the _exists and ownerOf authorization check.
_owner is the address whose balances and tokens are enumerated.
_tokensOfOwner is the returned enumeration array.
i iterates over the owner balance to fill the return array.

normalization_plan.reason: Quantity argument is only meaningful inside the PublicMint mint flow.
Twig id argument is consumed solely by the Feed maturity update.
Source twig id is used only for the ownership check inside TransferGraft.
Graft selector has no meaning outside the TransferGraft swap-and-pop.
Destination twig id is only used when pushing the moved graft entry.
Intermediate array index used only for the TransferGraft swap-and-pop.
Source twig id is used only for authorization and generation lookup in PlantGraft.
Graft selector is resolved and consumed entirely inside PlantGraft.
Array index used only to mature and remove the consumed graft.
Reserved mint recipient exists only within the AdminMint entry point.
Reserved amount feeds directly into the reserved counter cap check.
Withdrawal destination is the target of the native value transfer.
Withdrawal amount is the value emitted by the native transfer.
Owner supplied script is stored only by SetScript.
Price argument is applied only to the minPrice state variable.
Scheduling argument only writes FireSaleStartTime.
URI argument only writes the metaUri state variable.
Rendered twig id is only used to fetch twig data inside RenderTwig.
Render configuration is concatenated only into the RenderTwig output string.
Queried twig id is only used to build the GetTwigData script fragment.
Accumulator variable is internal to the GetTwigData serialisation loop.
Recipient is forwarded only into the _safeMint call inside _internalMint.
Loop bound for the internal mint is local to _internalMint.
Generation value is clamped and written only inside _internalMint.
Graft generation is used only for the graft generation bounds and structs.
Mint loop counter internal to _internalMint.
Random graft count exists only to bound the inner loop of _internalMint.
Inner graft creation counter internal to _internalMint.
Lower random bound is only used inside the random helper.
Upper random bound is only used inside the random helper.
Metadata token id is only used to build the tokenURI string.
Generation index is used solely to read GenLists in GetAllGen.
Intermediate time arithmetic exists only inside GetMintPrice.
Twig id is used only to select the graft array searched by CheckGraft.
Graft id is only compared against stored graft ids in CheckGraft.
Search loop counter internal to CheckGraft.
Twig id is used only for the existence and ownership assertion.
Owner address is only used to enumerate balances and token ids.
Return array is only meaningful inside GetTokenIds.
Enumeration loop counter internal to GetTokenIds.
